questions.title: Snippet Circular Queue Trace
questions.description: What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
cap = 4
q = [None] * cap
front = rear = count = 0
for x in [5, 6, 7]:
    q[rear] = x; rear = (rear + 1) % cap
    count += 1
q[front] = None; front = (front + 1) % cap; count -= 1
q[rear] = 8; rear = (rear + 1) % cap; count += 1
print(q, count)

questions.title: Two-Stack Queue Amortised Cost
questions.description: n elements are enqueued once and later dequeued once using the two-stack queue. What is the amortised cost per operation?
questions.Option1: O(n^2), because each transfer between stacks is quadratic
questions.Option2: O(log n), like a balanced search tree
questions.Option3: O(n) per dequeue, since every dequeue moves the entire stack
questions.Option4: O(1) amortised - each element is moved between stacks at most twice
